bullets.text: Led a SAP S/4HANA data integration project connecting enterprise transactional data to tax authority reporting, achieving full regulatory compliance and $30K in annual cost savings
Built and automated executive dashboards and KPI reports in Power BI and Tableau, reducing reporting turnaround time by 45% through automated data pipelines
Improved data quality and KPI accuracy by 25% by implementing data governance frameworks and validation rules across enterprise reporting systems
Built ABAP data extraction programs feeding interactive Power BI and Tableau dashboards, improving KPI tracking and self-service reporting across departments
Designed and deployed data analytics solutions to support regulatory reporting and operational decision making
Delivered actionable insights through statistical analysis and data visualization for senior management

projects.name: EY Urban Heat Island Data Challenge (Team Lead)
projects.description: Led a team that classified Urban Heat Island intensity using Sentinel 2 spectral indices and building footprint features, training on Santiago and Rio de Janeiro data and generalizing to Freetown, Sierra Leone. Built a Random Forest, XGBoost, KNN, and custom Residual MLP ensemble; the Residual MLP reached a macro F1 score of 0.90 on Rio de Janeiro, and a pseudo-labeled ensemble reached a cross-validated F1 of 0.86 on the unlabeled target city.

projects.name: New England Revolution (MLS) AI Strategy Challenge (Team Lead)
projects.description: Led a team that analyzed the club's fan and CRM data to develop a boardroom-ready AI adoption strategy for personalization and predictive fan engagement, presented to club leadership.

projects.name: Inventory Demand Forecasting
projects.description: Built an XGBoost regression model with calendar and lag features to forecast daily SKU demand, reducing mean absolute error by 20.15% versus a seasonal naive baseline.

projects.name: RFM Customer Segmentation
projects.description: Segmented customers on two years of transaction history using RFM scoring validated against k-means clustering, identifying two segments (48.08% of customers) that drive 86.18% of total revenue.

projects.name: A/B Testing and Experimentation
projects.description: Evaluated a checkout redesign using two-proportion z-tests and power analysis, finding a statistically significant 10.37% lift in conversion rate (p = 0.0016).
